# apple_assign_encryption_declaration (Action)

Assigns an encryption declaration to a build of the same app, which answers the build's export compliance question.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_assign_encryption_declaration" "latest" {
  config {
    build_id       = data.apple_build.latest.id
    declaration_id = apple_app_encryption_declaration.example.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
- `declaration_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the encryption declaration, e.g. `apple_app_encryption_declaration.example.id`.
